items.title: Randy Sandke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I did a gig not too long ago with Jon Gordon

ctx.x: Well you started out with some influence from your older brother?

And kind of, you are just about my age, and I remember listening to certain, a lot of pop music and then being greatly affected by groups like Blood, Sweat & Tears and stuff. Was that something — did you share that?
